svg.title: Mount of Olives — asymmetric olive-grove intaglio invitation carrier V11
svg.desc: Original registered botanical relief with an ancient cultivated olive tree and woodcut bark engraving in the outside gutter; a branch joins a foothill ridge and an etched skyline of Jerusalem across the short upper inscription area. Independent 04 identity, not the 03 Scripture cover. CC0 olive botanical references informed the natural leaf shape; all paths are original. The SVG is a pure alpha mask, colorized solely by Design OS ink.
